name: Abashiri Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Okhotsk coast around Lake Abashiri and the Abashiri and Shari rivers, famous for winter drift ice and the lake's shijimi clams.
notes: Managed by Hokkaido. The Garinko ice-breaker cruises and lake cruises are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
